cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
meeting_point: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815
description: Enjoy a personalized experience with the Beachboy Valet, where a genuine Waikīkī Beachboy will guide you through a variety of water activities. Spend the morning surfing, paddling across the reef, or riding an outrigger canoe. This unique service is tailored to beginners and intermediate surfers alike.
what_is_included:
- Personal Beachboy Valet for 3.5 hours
- All equipment, including surfboard, stand-up paddleboard, and outrigger canoe
- Use of a rash guard
what_is_not_included:
- Towel (unless a registered guest of The Royal Hawaiian)
- Storage for personal items or valuables
itinerary:
- Choose from surfing, stand-up paddling, or an outrigger canoe ride
- Spend time learning and enjoying various water activities with a personal guide
highlights:
- Personal Beachboy Valet for customized water activities
- Suitable for beginner and intermediate surfers
- Enjoy surfing, paddling, and canoeing under expert guidance
check_in_details: Check in at least 10 minutes before your reserved time at the service counter.
restrictions: - Pregnant women or guests with prior neck or back injuries should not participate in surfing or stand-up paddling.
faqs:
- **Can I choose which activities to do?** 
Yes, guests can choose from surfing, stand-up paddling, or outrigger canoe rides.
- **Is this suitable for beginners?** 
Yes, this experience is designed for beginners as well as intermediate surfers.
